layout.heading: Request Confirmed
layout.subheading: Your itinerary details are now with the Flight Experts team.
layout.body: A travel consultant will review your exact requirements and contact you directly with tailored flight and hotel options.

layout.heading: *Urgent* Assistance
layout.body: For immediate departures or urgent logistical changes, please contact our 24/7 global support desk directly:

image.alt: An empty airport departure lounge at dusk with a red suitcase

mobileImage.alt: An empty airport departure lounge at dusk with a red suitcase

cards.title: Direct Line
cards.body: Speak with your expert directly on [(888) 855-2389](tel:+18888552389), or request a callback at a time that suits you.

cards.title: Email
cards.body: Send an email to [experts@flight-experts.com](mailto:experts@flight-experts.com) and we'll reply with options.

steps.title: Initial Review
steps.text: A dedicated travel consultant is currently reviewing the itinerary details you just submitted.

steps.title: A Brief Conversation
steps.text: Expect a call from your consultant shortly. We prefer to speak with every client directly to understand your exact preferences, travel style, and specific needs before we begin searching.

steps.title: Sourcing Your Flights
steps.text: Based on our conversation, your consultant will check our private industry networks to find the most efficient routing and unlisted premium fares for your trip.

steps.title: Finalizing Your Itinerary
steps.text: We will present your tailored flight options. Once you select your preferred flights, you can check out securely. You only pay when the details are perfect and your tickets are ready to be issued.
